name: dsh-left-dock
description: Local persistent Web plugin: an IntelliJ-style left dock. Takes over the left sidebar column (the ui-sidebar row is disabled by this bundle's patch) and renders a two-button tool bar plus two mutually exclusive panels: the session sidebar (new session + sidebar.panellist rows + the real sidebar.workspaces browser + footer actions + settings) and a workspace file tree fed by remote.workspaceFiles. Each panel keeps its own width; clicking a file opens it in a conversation-area tab through the dsh-text-editor service. TypeScript: host half index.ts (type stripping), browser half src/client.ts → lib/client.js (esbuild, react external).
